acceptance: Either: Q16 and Q5 have a stated cause backed by plan or ProfileEvents differences, recorded in findings.md
Or: a second SF1 run with a different seed is recorded, and the item is closed because neither query reaches 1.5x with an interval above 1.0
Or: the owner closes it on the #4191 evidence, recording that neither trigger held
No template change is made unless the benefit rule names a loser
description:
## Problem
PR #4191's TPC-H SF1 cell (9 rounds, seed 42, ClickHouse 25.8.33.6, 5.25 GiB) found the tuned template a benefit overall (G 0.8230 [0.7803, 0.8777]) but two queries are slower under tuning with interval lower bounds above 1.0: Q16 1.485 [1.097, 2.064] and Q5 1.39 [1.085, 1.741]. Both are under the benefit rule's 1.5x named-loser bound, so no template change is required. Q5's plan, join algorithm, join sizes and peak memory are unchanged and fewer rows are read; the lost-order-key join-locality hypothesis is not supported. Q16 was not investigated.

## Decision gate
Investigate only if one of these holds; otherwise close with the existing evidence:
- A rerun (new seed, same host) shows Q16 or Q5 at or above 1.5x with an interval above 1.0 (the rule then names it a loser and requires action).
- A cheap cause is visible in the stored plans and ProfileEvents (_project/analysis/clickhouse-tuning-evidence-sf1/).

## Guardrails
- Do not retire a template setting on this evidence alone; the rule's thresholds decide.
- Compare plans and ProfileEvents between S (layout only) and T (full) before blaming session settings; S and T plans matched for Q3, Q5 and Q18 in #4191; Q16 has no plan capture yet.
- Reruns go through make heavy-run; if the host cannot hold them, see heavy-work-host-capacity-owner-decision-20261117.
